text: The meeting outlined actions to complete the final project report.

Several problems were identified: the speech recognition specification is missing/unclear; there is not enough time to design the interior; and the number and layout of buttons require clearer specification.

Decisions included using an advanced chip, including speech recognition in the product, establishing a prototype presentation order (PM first, then UI), and adopting a hard plastic casing to accommodate two D_ buttons.
Additional decisions cover a second level that should slide open, adoption of three colour buttons on the remote (red, yellow, and green) where space permits, and including a recharger in the unit.
